description.zh:
國家與城市：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

Python dictionary 在此章對應 map 或 unordered_map；需要字典序輸出時應選用 map 或另外排序鍵。
description.en:
Given a list of countries and cities of each country. Then given the names of the cities. For each city specify the country in which it is located.

C++ note: Use std::map or std::unordered_map. Choose map, or sort the keys separately, when lexicographic output is required.
